hero.eyebrow: Senior Frontend Engineering | Enterprise Commerce | Angular-ready Architecture
hero.headline: Juan Manuel Gomez
hero.subtitle: Senior Frontend / Full-stack Developer
hero.intro: I build accessible, maintainable, API-driven web experiences for enterprise commerce and business platforms, combining deep JavaScript and TypeScript experience with current hands-on Angular and React preparation.

about.title: Senior frontend experience with modern framework momentum
about.body: My strongest professional foundation is enterprise frontend delivery: Adobe Commerce / Magento 2, Salesforce UI work, TypeScript, JavaScript, integrations, production troubleshooting, reusable components, and technical leadership. I am currently applying recent Angular and React training to that senior-level foundation through hands-on portfolio and personal projects.
highlights: 10+ years of web and software development experience.
Technical Lead experience supporting planning, estimates, code reviews, debugging, and delivery oversight.
Professional eCommerce work across Adobe Commerce / Magento, BigCommerce, Salesforce, and API integrations.
Current Angular and React preparation backed by certifications and hands-on projects.

expertiseAreas.title: Frontend Architecture
expertiseAreas.summary: Reusable components, responsive layouts, accessible UI patterns, performance-minded implementation, and maintainable TypeScript code.

expertiseAreas.title: Adobe Commerce / Magento 2
expertiseAreas.summary: Frontend customization across PDP, category pages, cart, checkout, customer workflows, KnockoutJS, templates, modules, APIs, and production support.

expertiseAreas.title: Salesforce Development
expertiseAreas.summary: Hands-on work with LWC, Apex-supported user interfaces, Experience Builder, Salesforce OMS, OCI, flows, fulfillment workflows, and carrier integrations.

expertiseAreas.title: Modern Angular And React
expertiseAreas.summary: Current hands-on training and project work with Angular, Angular Material, reactive patterns, React, and component-driven frontend development.

projects.title: Adobe Commerce Configurable Product UX Optimization
projects.summary: Customized PDP behavior for configurable products so valid remaining attributes could be inferred automatically in applicable scenarios.
projects.impact: Reduced customer interaction from approximately 6-7 selections to as few as 1-2 when product configuration and inventory constraints allowed it.

projects.title: Salesforce Carrier Rate And Override Workflow
projects.summary: Built Apex-supported carrier quotation and LWC override workflows for warehouse and order fulfillment operations.
projects.impact: Integrated carrier quotation logic with services such as FedEx and Canada Post, giving users a way to validate and adjust selected carrier options.

projects.title: Angular SSR Portfolio Platform
projects.summary: This portfolio is built with Angular, Angular Material, SSR, accessible UI patterns, and a content repository architecture designed to migrate from json-server to WordPress.
projects.impact: Demonstrates current Angular implementation, architecture planning, accessibility, content decoupling, and performance-focused delivery.

experience.summary: Led frontend delivery for enterprise web and eCommerce applications across Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, and Salesforce environments.
bullets: Mentored developers through technical guidance, code reviews, debugging support, implementation planning, and delivery oversight.
Troubleshot production issues across UI components, API integrations, data flows, browser behavior, and platform-specific functionality.
Supported Salesforce, Magento, carrier, delivery, and third-party commerce integrations.

experience.summary: Developed responsive frontend experiences for eCommerce and web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, KnockoutJS, HTML5, CSS3, SASS, and platform-specific frontend technologies.
bullets: Built UI components, templates, page layouts, and customer-facing workflows for Adobe Commerce / Magento and other commerce platforms.
Implemented product discovery, account, cart, checkout, order management, and customer-service workflows.
Integrated frontend functionality with REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON data flows, and third-party platforms.

experience.summary: Developed web applications with MVC architecture, C#, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, and jQuery.
bullets: Developed a reusable centralized payment service for checkout pathways.
Used AngularJS professionally on a unified payment platform.
Worked with Sybase, SQL Server, and MySQL databases.
